scope: Automatic objective admission through the existing guardian-signed native licence command. No chain binary, governing whitepaper/FAQ, financial policy or member secret custody changes.

screening: Independently verified finalized native enrol event; consensus authenticated the original member signature
Proved pending member with matching canonical Ed25519 public key and derived native address
Declared name/operator minimum2 trimmed UTF-8 bytes and maxima120/200 bytes; optional family maximum100 bytes
Exact new enrol sequence1, zero Karma/credits/active projects, no creator/default-verifier role and no account overrides
Fresh active pinned guardian with matching public key, current guardian list and null guardian epoch pointer
reviewed_policy.no_fabricated_attestations: Signed terms consent, identity vetting and human review are not claimed; native enrol currently carries declared name/operator/family only.
reviewed_policy.evidence: A digest commits the objective policy, exact enrol event and independently proved member record; public signed bytes and evidence are durable before any broadcast.
reviewed_policy.refusal: Only typed member-policy eligibility failures can produce a durable refusal and advance the scan. Proof, guardian, pin, key binding and persistence failures remain fatal.
reviewed_policy.authority_limits: Only licence(active) may be signed. No roles, rewards, funding, monetary activation or reinstatement operations are exposed.

read_only_production_preflight.reported_by: Parent agent independently checked installed public verifier/genesis pins before preparing deployment
read_only_production_preflight.bootstrap: Installer captures an independently proved current event cursor/digest after checking no earlier pending members; later racing enrolments are processed rather than skipped.

bounds.network: Loopback only; service denies external IP access
bounds.paths: Fixed root-owned policy, private protected journals, source-loaded custody helper; no caller-controlled target or signing operation

recovery_checks: Unknown sends are never rebroadcast or silently re-signed
Failed durable signed artifact/journal/marker persistence prevents network submission
Crash after signed artifact retains and adopts its exact bytes
Expired or superseded attempts require proved complete non-inclusion and proof they can no longer execute before a fresh attempt
Other guardian activation does not release an uncertain signer sequence early
Only the exact independently proved command receipt is recorded as finalized
A refused candidate cannot poison a later eligible enrolment
Proof corruption and refusal persistence failure leave the cursor unchanged
Captured checkpoint initialization handles an enrol arriving before the first worker run
preflight_command: uain-custody check-native-admission verifies current native guardian authority and internally checks vault public binding without signing or submitting a command. It returns public metadata only.
